kv21.1:1.13: Pubbe akusalaṃ pacchā kusalaṃ katan ti?
kv21.1:1.15: Pubbe sāsavaṃ --pe-- saññojanīyaṃ gandhanīyaṃ oghanīyaṃ yoganīyaṃ nīvaraṇīyaṃ parāmaṭṭhaṃ upādāniyaṃ saṃkilesikaṃ pacchā asaṃkilesikaṃ katan ti?
kv21.1:2.1: Atthi koci Tathāgatassa sāsanaṃ navaṃ karotīti?
kv21.1:2.11: Atthi koci pubbe akusalaṃ pacchā kusalaṃ karotīti?
kv21.1:2.13: Atthi koci pubbe sāsavaṃ --pe-- saṃkilesikaṃ pacchā asaṃkilesikaṃ karotīti?
kv21.1:3.1: Labbhā Tathāgatassa sāsanaṃ puna navaṃ kātun ti?
kv21.1:3.3: Labbhā satipaṭṭhānā puna navaṃ kātun ti?
kv21.1:3.11: Labbhā pubbe akusalaṃ pacchā kusalaṃ kātun ti?
kv21.1:3.13: Labbhā pubbe sāsavaṃ --pe-- saṃkilesikaṃ pacchā asaṃkilesikaṃ kātun ti?
